title.narrative: Health Enhancement and Resiliency in Tonga Project

description.narrative: In order to achieve the objective, the Project will include four components: (i) Increase the capacity and resilience of Tonga to prevent, detect and effectively control NCDs which includes strengthening the service delivery for secondary prevention and control of diabetes and hypertension, support for overall policy formulation and implementation, population-based communication, and human resource development; (ii) Strengthen the accessibility to resilient health services in Vava’u which will include rebuilding and equipping the Prince Wellington Ngu Hospital, including meeting international resiliency and energy efficiency standards; (iii) Project and Portfolio Management which will included enhanced advisory support to support the coordination and management of the hospital development and includes support for the Central Services Unit that supports the preparation, implementation and completion of the entire Bank supported portfolio; and (iv) Contingency Emergency Response Component (CERC).

To strengthen the management of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) in Tonga, increase the availability of climate-resilient health services in the Northern Islands, and, in case of an eligible crisis or emergency, respond promptly and effectively to it.
